race.description: Bet365 Same Race Multi Mdn Plate
race.comment: JAPANESE MOKA (11) put in a good effort on debut when racing on the pace and sticking on resolutely to finish runner-up by just over a length at Hamilton 4 weeks ago. He will have the blinkers on this time, and with the natural improvement that is expected second up, he can go one better. CASTELLI IN ARIA (4) had just one start last prep in March, and was out aside after a disappointing effort. Her form last year was promising, and with a solid build up this season at the jump-outs, she should be ready to rumble fresh up. DO THE DIRTY (10) has been improving with racing. SHIELDS (18) settled off the pace on debut last time out but found the line nicely to finish fifth, beaten 1.4 lengths, over 1009m at Echuca. In the mix.
